objective: Fix the user-reported backward lean of the avatar while walking (reproduce it end to end first), and add a trophy cup on the highest terrace platform (terrace-2, top at 2.4 m) that the avatar collects with the dance clip.

projectContext.query: 3D playable game avatar locomotion animation canvas hero transition talking avatar gestures projects skills contact

acceptanceCriteria: Bug reproduced first: in the browser at 1440x900, walking and running are captured from a side camera with before screenshots and a measured torso pitch (hips-to-head or spine-chain angle from vertical, per clip phase) for idle, walk and run, compared with the same clip played on the plain unretargeted skeleton or the hero; the root cause is identified and stated (retarget rest offset, stance or body-clearance correction, clip blend or something else).

After the fix the avatar does not lean backward while walking or running: measured torso pitch stays between upright and the clip's own forward lean (never behind vertical) across a full walk and run cycle and during start, stop and turn transitions; side-view after screenshots show natural posture; feet stay planted with no new foot sliding or sinking; a test that would fail on b61b848 covers the corrected posture.

A trophy cup built from primitives or a recorded asset sits centred on top of terrace-2 (the highest terrace platform, reachable by the existing jumps), visible from the plaza side, collectible once by walking into it: the avatar plays the existing dance clip in place, the cup disappears with a short effect, a polite live region announces 'Trophy collected', and E or Interact is not required. Under reduced motion the dance still plays but no camera move or flash.

Trophy progress is saved in the existing progress record without breaking existing saved data: a stored version 1 record without the trophy field still loads with its cells and completion intact, reload restores a collected trophy (cup absent), Restart clears it, and storage failure falls back in memory; progress.test.ts and a trophy test cover uniqueness, persistence, legacy record loading and restart. ADR-005 is updated if the record shape changes.

No regression: the energy cell challenge, beacon celebration and completion panel still work; the tower passage camera sweep has 0 frames inside geometry or with the avatar hidden; rAF p95 under 17.5 ms walking at 1440x900; touch Interact and Jump still work at 390x844 in emulation; the trophy jump route is completed with keyboard and in touch emulation.

npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm test and npm run build exit 0 with exit codes explicitly captured (build in a copy of the tree), git diff --check b61b848 is clean, the hero (components/avatar/*) is unchanged, new content has no em dash or machine-local path, and no commit is made.
constraints: Work only inside the isolated worktree path supplied in the delegation prompt; do not commit; never run git stash, reset or checkout.
The user is play-testing on http://localhost:3100, served from a separate copy; do not stop or reload it. Run your own dev server from the worktree on port 3101 and stop it by exact PID; never pkill.

Every browser you launch must use a --user-data-dir inside your stage output directory, deleted on exit and failure via exit and SIGTERM handlers; check free disk and stop under 5 GB; run builds in a copy of the tree and delete it; never write evidence under the repository or .company.
Do not edit data/index.ts, lib/persona.ts, components/avatar/*, public/avatar.glb or public/animations/*; reuse public/animations/dance.glb; no new external asset unless recorded in ASSETS.md.
Record host load with every timing measurement.
Copy every acceptanceCriteria string verbatim into the report criteria array.
